risk_description:
The programming of the Pre-Collision System (PCS) feature may be improper, which could cause the application of the pre-crash brake assist function to be delayed.
This can result in less overall vehicle speed reduction than designed, increasing the risk of injury.
legal_provision:
The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles
and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical
units intended for such vehicles.
